method: Per block, keep the rounds the driver did not supersede; per kept round, read each new-side unit's cpuPerOpMs, compute every quantity below from that round's values, then reduce each quantity across rounds to a median with the driver's distribution-free interval (bench/ab.ts interval). layer:<rung> is that rung minus the rung before it on the typed-decode ladder (typed/tokenizer ... typed/decode-string, typed-document); layerOverC divides it by C. fusedResolverDelta is typed/resolve-fused minus typed/tokenizer.

definitions.Tr: typed-document rung (bench/profile/layers.ts): the same fromString(ItemBank) decode in the rung harness K is cut from
definitions.Kfused: typed/resolve-fused rung: whole-document tokenizer + resolveCollect (the shipped fused machine) under a path nothing matches (primary K)
definitions.Ktyped: typed/resolver rung: whole-document tokenizer + standalone resolveEvents (separate channel, overstates the shipped resolver)
definitions.Kdiff: differential resolver minus transport rung (64 KiB chunks), the driver's step2.K
definitions.Scaled: (1 - K / Tr) * (T / C): the T - K share measured inside the rung harness, applied to T / C measured inside the case harness
definitions.Kupper: typed/collector rung: tokenizer + resolveEvents piped to collect (upper bound: counts the collector too)
